info.title: GateCrash Township ERP API
info.description:
Visitor management and targeted notifications.

All endpoints except `/auth/login` and `/auth/refresh` require a bearer
access token. Accounts are admin-provisioned; there is no self-signup.
Until a user clears `mustResetPassword`, every endpoint outside
`/auth/**` returns 403 `PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED`.

post.summary: Guard logs a walk-in; routes to the flat's residents or a sales agent
Mint a time-bound pass; returns the PIN and QR token exactly once
Guard redeems a pass by PIN or QR; creates a CHECKED_IN visit immediately

get.summary: Sent history with recipient and delivery counts

post.summary: Resolve the audience, record recipients and dispatch
Dry run: how many people and devices this rule would reach
Register or refresh this device's FCM token
Rotate a refresh token for a new pair
Change own password; clears the forced-reset flag and ends other sessions
Revoke the supplied refresh token, or all sessions when none is given
Exchange login id and password for an access/refresh token pair
Provision an account; returns the generated password exactly once
Issue a new generated password and end every session for the account

Sales agent marks themselves on or off duty
